_comment: Scoped Vast.ai API key for automation that rents GPUs — vast-rent.sh, CI,
or an agent. Create it with:
vastai create api-key --name artemis-train \
--permission_file infra/vast/api-key-permissions.json
The console's +New button creates a FULL-ACCESS key by default. That key
can transfer credit, mint more keys, and read the whole account. None of
that is needed to rent a GPU, and a full-access key in a CI secret or an
agent's environment is a standing liability.
WHAT THIS GRANTS
misc            search offers (the rent path starts here)
instance_read   poll status, read logs — needed by the poll loop
instance_write  create and destroy instances, and volumes
user_read       read the credit balance for the pre-flight check
WHAT IT DELIBERATELY WITHHOLDS
billing_write   cannot transfer credit out of the account
user_write      cannot mint new keys, change the account, or alter the
spending thresholds. Set those once yourself with
scripts/train/vast-limits.sh and a key that has it.
team_read/write cannot enumerate or change team membership
machine_*       host-side operations; irrelevant to renting
A leaked key with this scope can still cost money by renting GPUs, so it
is not harmless — it is bounded. Rotate it with `vastai delete api-key
<id>` after a run if it ever left a trusted machine. The prepaid credit
balance remains the only hard ceiling on what any key can spend.
